title: Health, Metrics, Resilience & Background Jobs
objectives: Apply timeouts, retries and bounded queues to background work

examples.name: retry.rs

exercise.prompt: Classify job-system choices: "unbounded channel of jobs" (memory risk), "queue with max size + backpressure" (bounded), "retry forever, no cap" (runaway), "cancellation token checked between steps" (cancellable).
hints: Bounded queues apply backpressure instead of consuming memory.
Cancellation must be cooperative: check the token in the loop.

questions.prompt: Readiness differs from liveness because readiness reports…
options: whether the service can handle traffic now (deps OK, warm)
questions.explanation: Liveness = restart me if stuck; readiness = send/halt traffic based on real capacity.

questions.prompt: Bounded queues in background systems provide…
options: backpressure — overload degrades instead of consuming all memory
questions.explanation: A capped queue refuses/throttles new work; an unbounded one grows until it dies.
